instruction.name: vbsrl.v
instruction.description: Shift each 128-bit lane of `a` right by `(imm % 16) * 8` bits, filling the vacated bits with zeros.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: vbsrl.v $vr0, $vr8, 1; vbsrl.v $vr1, $vr9, 1; vbsrl.v $vr2, $vr10, 1; vbsrl.v $vr3, $vr11, 1; vbsrl.v $vr4, $vr12, 1; vbsrl.v $vr5, $vr13, 1; vbsrl.v $vr6, $vr14, 1; vbsrl.v $vr7, $vr15, 1
throughput.init: li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr8, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr9, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr10, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr11, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr12, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr13, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr14, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr15, $r4
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 7 --init 'li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr8, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr9, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr10, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr11, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr12, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr13, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr14, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr15, $r4' --asm 'vbsrl.v $vr0, $vr8, 1; vbsrl.v $vr1, $vr9, 1; vbsrl.v $vr2, $vr10, 1; vbsrl.v $vr3, $vr11, 1; vbsrl.v $vr4, $vr12, 1; vbsrl.v $vr5, $vr13, 1; vbsrl.v $vr6, $vr14, 1; vbsrl.v $vr7, $vr15, 1'
throughput.notes: 8 independent instructions take 1.99 cycles. The measured CPI 0.2487 is the nominal 0.25 within measurement noise; the value is reported as the nominal figure.

notes: LSX vector instruction. Measured on LA664 with integer vector operands.
